question: Which labeled perturbations show increased RNA for their named target transcript against the same inference controls? How do four explicitly author-mapped alternative gene symbols behave? RNA induction is not proof of protein function, on-target specificity or biological replication.
design: All105 sufficiently sampled single labels, identical5926 discovery/5929 inference controls and gemgroup stratification. All-gene library normalization10000 and log1p before extracting target transcripts; no HVG restriction. Score one transcript directly, with no discovery-expression minimum or three-marker gate. Retain missing transcript comparisons as p1/unscored. Stratified one-sided Mann-Whitney and AUC use existing _compare_up, minimum20 cells.
mapping_source: Original authors' name_replacer in GI_sgRNA_performance.ipynb cell8, exact Git blob59accd93f736d85a41b0dda736538ba473bf442a. These are recorded alternative transcript labels, not assumed universal synonyms; RHOXF2/RHOXF2B may be distinct paralogous targets and exact guide sequence specificity is not established.
family: All105 direct-name comparisons plus all4 declared alternative-transcript comparisons enter one BH family of109, including absent p1 records. A target-RNA increase requires q<.05 and AUC>=.55. Preserve every negative and unscored result; never remove labels from previous analyses based on this diagnostic.
preidentified_cases: Original-author code comments exclude BAK1 and BCL2L11 with an unexplained statement that they do not work. Report both here without assuming whether their RNA induction, protein activity, survival or another endpoint failed. KLF1's earlier TF-panel self-target trap is contextual evidence, not independent validation of this diagnostic.
outputs: All109 comparisons, direct/alternative status, actual observed gene coverage, p/q/AUC/cell counts, exact existing control split, source/input hashes and software versions. Fresh exclusive output; archive compact complete records.
limits: Single-guide and technical-partition limitations persist. Observed RNA induction is neither protein activity nor a validated causal gene mechanism. Lack of a call can reflect ties, assay coverage or limited effect size. Alternative labels are not asserted equivalent genes. No target-specific phenotype, novelty or SAE advantage follows. Do not use this post-outcome screen to select favorable original results.
